scope: Mode 2 portable IC-CPDs and Mode 3 AC wallboxes up to 22 kW IEC / ~12 kW NA Level 2. Public datasheets 2024–2026.

manufacturers.name: ABB
manufacturers.notes: Industrial-grade Terra AC. ADAC 2025 joint 2nd (note 1.7) for Terra AC W11-G5-RD-PC-0. IEC 7.4/11/22 kW and UL up to 80 A / 19 kW. ChargerSync + TerraConfig apps.

products.name: Terra AC / Terra AC 2.0 IEC
products.rcd: 6 mA DC residual (RDC-DD); external Type A RCD

manufacturers.name: KEBA
manufacturers.notes: ADAC 2025 company-car wallbox winner: KeContact P40 (note 1.6). P30 remains the volume install base. P40 Pro is ISO 15118 hardware-ready (Plug & Charge / V2G path) with integrated phase switching for PV.

manufacturers.name: Wallbox
manufacturers.notes: Pulsar family is the compact residential staple. Plus = Wi-Fi/BT, IP54. Max = Ethernet, IP55/IK10, OCPP. Power Boost / Eco-Smart need an external meter. Copper SB / Pulsar Pro for business. Quasar is bidirectional (out of 22 kW AC-only scope).

products.name: Pulsar Plus
products.rcd: 6 mA DC RDC-DD; external Type A/B per local code

manufacturers.name: Easee
manufacturers.notes: Compact ‘charging robot’ on a backplate. Fully dynamic 1φ/3φ including Norwegian IT (max ~12.7 kW at 32 A 3φ IT). Built-in Type B-class RCD. Equalizer for whole-building load/PV. OCPP 1.6 via Easee API (not always native box-to-backend).

products.name: Easee Home / Charge / Charge Max
products.rcd: integrated AC 30 mA + DC 6 mA (Type B characteristic)

manufacturers.name: Zaptec
manufacturers.notes: Strong in apartment / workplace load and phase balancing. Go / Go 2 for homes; Pro for sites (PLC between units). TN/IT/TT. Go 2: MID Class B, ISO 15118 hardware, RFID, LCD. ADAC 2025 Zaptec Pro M&E note 1.8.

manufacturers.name: Alfen
manufacturers.notes: Benelux install-base leader. Eve Single S-line (11 kW 3φ) vs Pro-line (22 kW). Certified OCPP 1.6 2nd edition and 2.0.1. P1 / Modbus / Linky TIC for smart charging. Eichrecht DE SKUs. ADAC 2025 Eve Single Pro-line note 1.9.

products.name: Eve Single S-line / Pro-line
products.rcd: 6 mA DC residual; external RCD per local code

manufacturers.name: EVBox
manufacturers.notes: Elvi (home) and Livo / BusinessLine for workplace. Type 2, load balancing, OCPP. Brand has gone through ownership changes — check current SKU and support in the target country.

manufacturers.name: Mennekes
manufacturers.notes: Origin of the Type 2 connector. AMTRON 4You (home) and 4Business (OCPP, Eichrecht). ADAC 2025 AMTRON 4Business note 1.9.

manufacturers.name: go-e
manufacturers.notes: Gemini is the wall-mounted Mode 3 unit. Gemini flex is the portable Mode 2 IC-CPD (CEE inlet + adapters). Open HTTP/MQTT/Modbus API. Charger PRO: MID, ISO 15118 / V2X hardware-ready, OCPP 1.6, IP66, §14a EnWG.

manufacturers.name: Amperfied / Heidelberg
manufacturers.notes: Former Heidelberg Wallbox (Energy Control / Connect). Analog 0–10 V / PWM load management without a cloud. Energy Control is the cheap, robust, no-app option. Connect adds WLAN/OCPP. Brand now Amperfied (Porsche/Volkswagen group industrial).

manufacturers.name: ABL
manufacturers.notes: eMH1 is the classic simple German wallbox (ADAC 1.0 in 2018). eM4 Single/Twin is the current connected/Eichrecht line. ADAC 2025 eM4 Single note 1.9.

manufacturers.name: Schneider Electric
manufacturers.notes: EVlink Home / Schneider Charge for dwellings (Wiser). EVlink Pro AC / Smart Wallbox for workplace (OCPP, MID, RFID). 6 mA DC filter on Home. EcoStruxure for sites.

products.name: EVlink Home / Schneider Charge
products.rcd: 6 mA DC filter; external 30 mA Type A-SI

products.name: EVlink Pro AC / Smart Wallbox
products.rcd: RDC-DD 6 mA on Pro AC SKUs

manufacturers.name: Siemens
manufacturers.notes: VersiCharge IEC 7.4/22 kW Type 2; UL versions 48–80 A J1772. Modbus, app, some OCPP SKUs. Building-automation integration (Desigo).

manufacturers.name: Tesla
manufacturers.notes: Gen 3 Wall Connector is Mode 3. NA: 12–48 A @ 208/240 V (11.5 kW), CCID20, NACS or Universal (J1772). IEC/TW: Type 2, up to 32 A 1φ (7 kW) or 32 A 3φ (22 kW on 400 V). Mobile Connector is the Mode 2 travel IC-CPD with plug adapters.

manufacturers.name: ChargePoint
manufacturers.notes: Home Flex: 16–50 A @ 208/240 V (max 12 kW), J1772 or NACS, NEMA 6-50/14-50 or hardwire. Plug-in limited to 32/40 A. UL 2594/2231, ENERGY STAR. Wi-Fi, ChargePoint app. Commercial AC stations (CT4000 etc.) are a different product line.

products.name: Home Flex
products.rcd: CCID / internal GFCI; do not double-up GFCI breaker

manufacturers.name: Emporia
manufacturers.notes: Wirecutter 2026 top pick (Classic). 40 A plug-in or 48 A hardwired @ 240 V (11.5 kW). J1772 or NACS. Tight integration with Emporia Vue energy monitor for solar/load. UL listed, 24–25 ft cable.

manufacturers.name: Autel Energy
manufacturers.notes: MaxiCharger AC Elite Home (up to 50 A NA / 22 kW IEC), AC Pro, AC Ultra. App, RFID on business SKUs, OCPP on commercial. Aggressive retail pricing in NA.

products.name: MaxiCharger AC Elite Home
products.rcd: 6 mA DC / CCID depending on SKU

manufacturers.name: Delta Electronics
manufacturers.notes: Taiwan/EU AC Mini Plus 32 A / 7 kW Type 1 or Type 2 (CNS 15511). EIAW-T up to 48–80 A single-phase 220 V (~10.5–17.6 kW). Recommends a dedicated 40 A 2P breaker for 32 A units. Also large DC portfolio.

manufacturers.name: Evalue / ChargingBOLT
manufacturers.notes: Taiwan-market wallboxes with adjustable 16/24/32/40/50 A @ 220 V 60 Hz. 40 A SKU = 8.8 kW on a 50 A RCCB. Type 1 (J1772) and Type 2. CNS 15511 + VPC. Requires Type B or EV Type A RCCB in TW.

products.name: CSDA / CBDA X-series
products.rcd: external Type B or EV Type A RCCB (TW rule)

manufacturers.name: Fronius
manufacturers.notes: Wattpilot Home is the Mode 3 wallbox. Wattpilot Go is the portable Mode 2 unit (CEE inlet). PV surplus with Fronius inverters (Solar.web). 11 kW (16 A) or 22 kW (32 A).

manufacturers.name: myenergi
manufacturers.notes: Zappi: 7 kW 1φ (UK) or 22 kW 3φ export SKUs. Eco / Eco+ solar diversion with harvi/CT. OCPP on later firmware. PEN-fault protection for UK PME. Very common with UK PV.

manufacturers.name: Charge Amps
manufacturers.notes: Dawn Professional DE: ADAC 2025 joint 2nd (1.7). Halo is the design-led home unit. Nordic cold-weather focus, OCPP, RFID.

manufacturers.name: Smappee
manufacturers.notes: EV Wall / EV Base tied to Smappee Infinity energy monitoring. ADAC 2025 EV Wall Eichrecht note 1.8. Strong solar and whole-home EMS, not the cheapest wallbox.

manufacturers.name: Huawei
manufacturers.notes: FusionCharge AC: native PV surplus with Huawei inverters/dongle. 7–22 kW Type 2. FusionSolar app. Best when the site already has a Huawei PV stack.

manufacturers.name: Hypervolt
manufacturers.notes: What Car? 2025 owner-survey winner (low fault rate). Home 2.0 / 3: 7 kW 1φ Type 2, solar, PEN protection, app. UK-centric.

manufacturers.name: Ohme
manufacturers.notes: Home Pro is the Mode 3 7 kW wallbox (tariff-aware, Octopus, PEN). ePod is the Mode 2 portable 13 A / ~3 kW smart granny charger.

manufacturers.name: NRGkick (DiniTech)
manufacturers.notes: Portable IC-CPD. Mode 2 (IEC 62752) on household/CEE sockets; Mode 3 when using the Type 2 smart attachment on a Mode 3 outlet. Up to 22 kW, IP67, temperature-monitored attachments, optional ISO 15118 / MID SKUs.

products.name: NRGkick
products.rcd: 30 mA AC + 6 mA DC; PE/loop-impedance test

manufacturers.name: Juice Technology
manufacturers.notes: Juice Booster is a drive-over IC-CPD: portable Mode 2 on household/CEE adapters, Mode 3 as a Type 2 charging cable. Booster 2/3 up to 22 kW; Booster 3 air up to 11 kW.

products.name: Juice Booster 2 / 3
connector: Juice Connector adapters (Schuko, CEE, Type 2, NEMA)

products.name: Juice Booster 3 air
auth: RFID in Type 2 plug on some

manufacturers.name: Ratio Electric
manufacturers.notes: Dutch maker of wallboxes and portable IC-CPDs. io6 / Solar are Mode 3; the Mobile / Travel units are Mode 2 with CEE or Schuko.

manufacturers.name: CTEK
manufacturers.notes: NJORD GO is a compact Mode 3 home charger; Chargestorm Connected is the workplace line. Also sells Mode 2 travel chargers (Njord Go is wall; CTEK Njord / portable SKUs exist in some markets).
